verdict.rationale: Notte's docs give a one-line stance that its remote browsers include "captcha solving" (notte-docs-1). The founder separately said about 60% of captcha providers are solved, including reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare, with others still in progress (notte-comm-7). That admits incomplete coverage rather than contradicting the claim. Nothing in the pack documents which providers are covered or what happens when solving fails, so silent failures on unsupported captchas remain possible. Missing for 10: a dedicated captcha documentation page, a documented list of supported vs. unsupported providers, documented failure signaling or error behavior, a documented human-in-the-loop fallback (live view exists but is not tied to captcha handling), and independent hands-on corroboration.
